user_message:
Speech context: Greta Thunberg, Address to the UN Climate Action Summit, United Nations Headquarters, New York, 2019-09-23.

Annotate every numbered sentence below. Return one entry per sentence, using the number in brackets as seg_id.

[3] My message is that we'll be watching you.
[4] This is all wrong.
[5] I shouldn't be up here.
[6] I should be back in school on the other side of the ocean.
[7] Yet you all come to us young people for hope.
[8] How dare you?
[9] You have stolen my dreams and my childhood with your empty words.
[10] And yet I'm one of the lucky ones.
[11] People are suffering.
[12] People are dying.
[13] entire ecosystems are collapsing.
[14] We are in the beginning of a mass extinction, and all you can talk about is money and fairy tales of eternal economic growth.
[15] How dare you?
[16] For more than 30 years, the science has been crystal clear.
[17] How dare you continue to look away and come here saying that you're doing enough when the politics and solutions needed are still nowhere in sight.
[18] You say you hear us and that you understand the urgency.
[19] But no matter how sad and angry I am, I do not want to believe that.
[20] Because if you really understood the situation and still kept on failing to act,
[21] then you would be evil, and that I refuse to believe.
[22] The popular idea of cutting our emissions in half in 10 years only gives us a 50% chance of staying below 1.5 degrees and the risk of setting off irreversible chain reactions beyond human control.
[23] 50% may be acceptable to you.
[24] But those numbers do not include tipping points, most feedback loops, additional warming hidden by toxic air pollution or the aspects of equity and climate justice.
[25] They also rely on my generation sucking hundreds of billions of tons of your CO2 out of the air with technologies that barely exist.
[26] So a 50% risk is simply not acceptable to us.
[27] we who have to live with the consequences.
[28] To have a 67% chance of staying below a 1.5 degrees of global temperature rise, the best odds given by the IPCC, the world had 420 gigatons of CO2 left to emit back on January 1st, 2018.
[29] Today, that figure is already down to less than 350 gigatons.
[30] How dare you pretend that this can be sold with just business as usual and some technical solutions?
[31] With today's emissions levels, that remaining CO2 budget will be entirely gone within less than eight and a half years.
[32] There will not be any solutions or plans presented in line with these figures here today because these numbers are too uncomfortable
[33] And you are still not mature enough to tell it like it is.
[34] You are failing us.
[35] But the young people are starting to understand your betrayal.
[36] The eyes of all future generations are upon you.
[37] And if you choose to fail us, I say we will never forgive you.
[38] We will not let you get away with this.
[39] Right here, right now is where we draw the line.
[40] The world is waking up and change is coming whether you like it or not.
[41] Thank you.
